messages.text:
"Create a new game project called RAT COUTURE.

This is a surreal, grotesque underground fashion competition game.

VISUAL IDENTITY: Combine avant-garde fashion editorial aesthetics with underground punk comic art.

The world should feel strange, extravagant, dirty, artistic and darkly humorous.

MAIN MENU:

Create a visually impressive main menu featuring:

Large RAT COUTURE logo
NEW GAME button
CONTINUE button
SETTINGS button
QUIT button

BACKGROUND:

An underground fashion runway in a surreal abandoned building.

Include:

Dramatic red spotlights
Dirty pink curtains
Industrial walls
Fashion posters
Acid green details
Strange decorative objects
Underground punk atmosphere

ART STYLE:

Stylized 2D illustrations
Grotesque fashion characters
Experimental typography
Strong contrasts
Avant-garde editorial composition

FUNCTIONALITY:

NEW GAME opens a placeholder character creation screen.
CONTINUE loads saved progress if available.
SETTINGS opens a settings screen.
All navigation buttons must work.

TECHNICAL:

Create a clean, modular project structure.

Keep the project easy to expand.

Do not build the entire game yet.

This is Phase 1 of a larger project.

Focus on creating a polished and functional main menu.

The result must be an actual playable project, not just a static design mockup.

---
This is a build request. Build a complete, playable game now (or apply the requested change to the existing game). Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and note them briefly when you finish.
"
